name: Altenberge (Germany)
description: Yellow field with a red horizontal band across the fly, the hoist part charged with the municipal arms of Altenberge (a green tree on a mount above a ploughshare on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Altenberge; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Altenberge arms — tree and ploughshare on yellow
